print_orientation: vertical, dispense end (Z=0) on the build plate

pauses.name: ERM disc insertion
pauses.part: Adafruit #1201 vibrating motor disc (Ø10 × 2.7 mm, 3 V)
pauses.instructions: Pause printer at this Z. The +X radial pocket (Ø10.3 × 2.9 mm) is now open along with the short Ø2.5 × 2 mm radial wire-egress slot directly out the +X face beside the pocket. Epoxy the ERM coin into the pocket with leads exiting through the egress slot. Route leads down/around to the e-bay grommet (z = ~117 mm, -Y face). Resume to encapsulate the disc.

pauses.name: Solenoid insertion
pauses.part: Adafruit #412 JF-0530B 5 V mini push-pull solenoid (9.6 × 19 × 22 mm)
pauses.instructions: Pause printer at this Z. Insert the JF-0530B body into the -X pocket (plunger pointing toward the auger bore through the 2.5 × 6 mm slot). Route leads through the short radial 2.5 × 3 mm wire-egress slot out the -X face beside the pocket. Resume to lock the solenoid in place.

install_after_print.name: Heat-set inserts
install_after_print.instructions: Press M3 brass heat-set inserts into the lid corner holes (Ø4.0 × 5.5 mm deep, 4× around the e-bay opening), the servo flange holes (2× Ø 4.0 × 5.5 mm on the +Y face), and the +X coupler grub-screw access ports if you choose to plug them with grub-screw heads. Press M2.5 inserts into the stepper plate (4× Ø3.6 × 4.5 mm on a 23 × 23 mm pattern on the top plate) and into the 4 Pi standoff posts inside the e-bay.

install_after_print.name: Metal-gear servo install
install_after_print.instructions: Slide the servo into the +Y pocket (now blind — stops 1 mm short of the auger bore; only the 6 × 8 mm horn-side slot punches through to the bore). Bolt with 2× M3 into the inserted flange holes.

install_after_print.name: Pi Zero 2 W mount
install_after_print.part: Pi Zero 2 W on the +Y inner wall of the e-bay
install_after_print.instructions: Bolt the Pi Zero 2 W flat onto the 4 standoffs on the +Y inner wall of the bay (58 × 23 mm pattern, M2.5 into heat-sets). Orient the board so the mini-HDMI / micro-USB OTG / micro-USB power connector edge faces the -Z bay-floor cable slot (cables exit downward toward the desk).

install_after_print.name: Adafruit Stepper Bonnet stack
install_after_print.part: Adafruit Stepper Motor Bonnet (~65 × 30 × 15 mm) on Pi GPIO
install_after_print.instructions: Press the Bonnet onto the Pi GPIO 2 × 20 header. The Bonnet's screw terminals face -Y (toward the lid) so motor + sensor leads land in the bay cavity ahead of them.

install_after_print.name: Pololu Tic 500 stepper controller
install_after_print.instructions: VHB-tape (3M VHB 5952) the Tic 500 flat against the -X internal sidewall of the e-bay, board facing into the cavity, screw terminals facing -Y. Connects to the Bonnet via I2C/USB.

install_after_print.name: DRV8825 stepper driver carrier (alternate)
install_after_print.instructions: VHB-tape the DRV8825 onto the +X internal sidewall of the e-bay, opposite the Tic 500. Used as a fallback for the Bonnet's onboard drivers if the Bonnet is reassigned to the servo/solenoid only.

install_after_print.name: E-bay lid
install_after_print.instructions: Print the matching lid (70 × 80 × 2.5 mm with 4 M3 clearance holes at the corners) separately and bolt to the heat-set inserts at the corners of the -Y opening.

install_after_print.name: Stepper + coupler install (top)
install_after_print.instructions: Slide the ST-FC01 coupler into the Ø19 × 26 mm chamber. Drop the auger M3 spindle into one side, the stepper's Ø5 D-cut into the other. Tighten the two coupler grub screws via the two Ø3.5 mm access ports on the +X face (these line up with the ST-FC01 set screws). Bolt the stepper to the top plate with 4 × M2.5 into the heat-set inserts (23 × 23 mm pattern, Ø22 pilot pass-through). Route the 4 stepper leads down the +X vertical wire slot and into the e-bay through the Ø5 grommet near z ≈ 122 mm.

wiring.summary: All four electrical leads (ERM, solenoid, servo, stepper) terminate inside the -Y e-bay at the Adafruit Stepper Bonnet (Pi GPIO) or the Pololu Tic 500, depending on signal type.

paths.via: Short +X radial egress slot → down chassis -Y face → into e-bay through main lid opening (or optional grommet at z = 117)
Short -X radial egress slot → around bottom of chassis → into e-bay lid opening
Around top of chassis → into e-bay lid opening
Down the +X vertical wire slot → through the Ø5 grommet at z=122 → directly to driver
paths.to: Tic 500 (or Bonnet onboard) A1/A2/B1/B2 outputs (12 V)

notes: Pause Z is in millimetres along the chassis Z axis (matches the CadQuery script). Layer index = round(z_mm / layer_height_mm) at 0.2 mm; rescale if you slice differently. v2 design fixes (vs v1): Pi reoriented for connector egress (a); servo pocket no longer punches through the bore (b); short radial wire-egress slots for ERM/solenoid (c); proper Pi+Bonnet+Tic500+DRV8825 e-bay sidecar (d); all mounting holes sized for heat-set brass inserts (e); two grub-screw access ports for the ST-FC01 coupler (f).
